Bug_Title: Nm: Class defines equal(Object); should it be equals(Object)? (NM_BAD_EQUAL)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a method equal(Object).  This method does
not override the equals(Object) method in java.lang.Object,
which is probably what was intended. equal(Object) equals(Object) java.lang.Object
